top_categories.workout_context: Love Tiles Douro Granfondo's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Love Tiles Douro Granfondo's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
At Love Tiles Douro Granfondo, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Love Tiles Douro Granfondo. Train it until it feels boring.
At mile 60 of 87, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.

Road-specific control matters at Love Tiles Douro Granfondo. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 87 miles.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 87 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Love Tiles Douro Granfondo's mixed terrain actually does to you.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 87 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.

race_overlay.weather: April in Peso da Régua, Douro Valley, Portugal. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before Love Tiles Douro Granfondo. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Love Tiles Douro Granfondo’s 87 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Love Tiles Douro Granfondo. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Race Simulation, and VO2max to prepare you for 87 miles of mixed terrain in Peso da Régua, Douro Valley, Portugal.
